qa_pairs.question: In 2022, assuming the total population of China is 1.4 billion and the proportion of single - living people in the age group of 60 and above is the same as the overall proportion, please estimate the size of the elderly single - living population. Keep 3 decimal places, and the unit is in billions of people.
qa_pairs.explanation: Population aged 60 and above = 1.4 billion × 19.8% = 277.2 million; The proportion of single - living people is 146 million / 1.4 billion. Estimate the size of the elderly single - living population: 277.2 million × 146000000 / 1400000000 = 0.1386 ≈ 0.289 billion people.

qa_pairs.question: In China's pet consumption in 2019, estimate the market size of pet food (assuming the pet consumption structure is the distribution of market size proportion). The unit is in billions of yuan, and keep 1 decimal place.

Assume that the market sizes of the Chinese and American pet markets were the same in 2021 and the market sizes grow proportionally according to the penetration rate. Estimate the size of the American pet market in 2022. Keep 2 decimal places.
qa_pairs.explanation: Converted by the penetration rate, 311.7 billion yuan in China corresponds to 22%; then the American pet market = 311.7 × (1.70 / 1.22) ≈ 4343.36 billion yuan.
